general_information.Description: This course provides students with the knowledge and experience necessary for success in the entertainment industry. It comprises two parts: First, "Entertainment Business Foundations," which focuses on the music industry, provides a comprehensive overview, including the industry's history and role dynamics. In the second section, you'll explore the intersection of fandom, popular culture, and digital media, learning how to analyse popular culture products, map fan networks, and understand the links between popular culture and the political and commercial factors that shape its production, distribution, and consumption.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded) 4. Communicate and discuss in forum 5. Attend offline sessions in the Campus (Optional) 6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
general_information.Note: 1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 2) Theoretical Exam (TE) 3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE + Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Gain comprehension of theoretical and practical expertise for a music industry vocation
Possess a high level of proficiency proficiency in shaping artist identity, cultivating fanbases, and mastering entrepreneurship
Demonstrate the ability to analyze links between popular culture, politics, and commercial influences.
Develop the capacity to influence fan identity online and engage in cooperative efforts to establish a community-driven platform for fandom.
Develop self-study and lifelong learning spirit and capabilities to adapt to the constant change of technology and society.
